name: Lithium
tagline: The backbone of the EV revolution

chokePoints.title: Chinese Refining Dominance
chokePoints.description: 65% of global lithium refining capacity sits in China. Any trade disruption immediately threatens global battery supply chains.

substituteMineral: Sodium-ion batteries (emerging, lower energy density)
recyclingSources: European Commission Critical Raw Materials Report 2023

esgRisks.summary: Lithium brine extraction in the Atacama Desert consumes vast quantities of freshwater, threatening local ecosystems and indigenous water access.

timeline.event: Sony commercializes the first rechargeable lithium-ion battery
timeline.impact: Revolutionized portable electronics; enabled modern smartphones and laptops

timeline.event: Tesla launches the Roadster, first mass-market EV with lithium-ion battery
timeline.impact: Proved lithium-ion technology could power high-performance vehicles

timeline.event: Nobel Prize awarded to Goodenough, Whittingham & Yoshino for lithium-ion battery
timeline.impact: Global recognition of lithium-ion as transformative technology

timeline.event: Chile announces plans to nationalize its lithium industry
timeline.impact: World's largest lithium reserve holder asserts state control over strategic resource

timeline.event: Global lithium oversupply causes prices to crash 80% from 2022 peak
timeline.impact: Market correction forces mine closures and project delays worldwide

name: Cobalt
tagline: Thermal stability for high-energy batteries

chokePoints.title: DRC Production Concentration
chokePoints.description: 73% of raw cobalt is extracted in the Democratic Republic of Congo, posing significant supply stability and ESG risks.

chokePoints.title: Chinese Refining Monopoly
chokePoints.description: China controls nearly 75% of global cobalt refining, creating a tight bottleneck for battery manufacturers globally.

substituteMineral: Iron Phosphate (LFP) cathode chemistry eliminates cobalt entirely

esgRisks.summary: Artisanal cobalt mining in the DRC involves widespread child labor and hazardous working conditions, with an estimated 40,000 children working in mines.
Revenue from cobalt mining has been linked to financing armed groups in eastern DRC provinces.

timeline.event: Chinese firms begin massive investment in DRC cobalt mining
timeline.impact: DRC becomes dominant global supplier; Chinese control of cobalt supply chain grows

timeline.event: Amnesty International exposes child labor in DRC cobalt mines
timeline.impact: Landmark report forces Apple, Samsung to audit supply chains; public outcry

timeline.event: DRC introduces new mining code raising cobalt royalties
timeline.impact: Cobalt declared a 'strategic substance' with 10% royalty rate

timeline.event: LFP battery chemistry gains ground, eliminating cobalt entirely
timeline.impact: Tesla and others adopt cobalt-free LFP, reducing dependency on DRC supply

timeline.event: DRC cobalt production reaches ~130,000 tonnes, 73% of world output
timeline.impact: Concentration risk remains extreme despite industry diversification efforts

name: Nickel
tagline: Energy density for long-range EVs

chokePoints.title: Class 1 Nickel Shortage
chokePoints.description: While general nickel is abundant, Class 1 nickel (required for EV batteries) is facing supply deficits.

substituteMineral: LFP batteries (lower energy density but cobalt/nickel-free)

esgRisks.summary: Rapid nickel smelter expansion in Indonesia has caused widespread deforestation of tropical rainforest and toxic tailings dumped into coastal waters.

timeline.event: Indonesia implements first full nickel ore export ban
timeline.impact: Forced foreign companies to build domestic smelters; shifted global supply dynamics

timeline.event: Indonesia reinstates full nickel ore export ban
timeline.impact: Global nickel prices surge; massive Chinese-Indonesian smelter investment

timeline.event: LME nickel short squeeze causes prices to spike above $100,000/tonne
timeline.impact: Historic market disruption; trading suspended for several days on London Metal Exchange

timeline.event: Indonesian nickel export value reaches $30 billion
timeline.impact: Downstreaming policy success transforms Indonesia into nickel processing hub

timeline.event: Indonesia dominates 48% of world nickel production
timeline.impact: Environmental concerns grow over coal-powered smelters and deforestation

name: Copper
tagline: The metal of electrification

chokePoints.title: Declining Ore Grades
chokePoints.description: Global copper ore grades are declining, requiring more energy and investment to extract the same amount of metal.

substituteMineral: Aluminum (partial substitute in power cables, but inferior conductivity)

timeline.event: Chile nationalizes copper mines under President Allende
timeline.impact: Created Codelco, now the world's largest copper producer

timeline.event: Escondida mine begins operations in Chile's Atacama Desert
timeline.impact: Becomes the world's largest copper mine, producing ~5% of global supply

timeline.event: Escondida experiences 44-day strike, longest in Chilean mining history
timeline.impact: Massive production losses cause global copper price spikes

timeline.event: IEA projects copper demand to double by 2040 for clean energy transition
timeline.impact: Electrification megatrend creates structural demand growth

timeline.event: Global copper ore grades continue declining, averaging below 0.6%
timeline.impact: Rising extraction costs and environmental footprint per tonne of copper produced

name: Graphite
tagline: The anode essential

chokePoints.title: Total Refining Monopoly
chokePoints.description: China controls nearly 100% of the world's spherical graphite refining capacity, making battery anodes fully dependent on one nation.

substituteMineral: Silicon-carbon composite anodes (emerging technology, higher capacity)

esgRisks.summary: Graphite processing in China generates significant air pollution (graphite dust) and acid waste, affecting nearby communities.

timeline.event: Graphite adopted as the standard anode material in lithium-ion batteries
timeline.impact: Created massive new demand vector beyond traditional refractory uses

timeline.event: China's Export Control Law takes effect for graphite controls
timeline.impact: Legal foundation for subsequent restrictions on battery-critical materials

timeline.event: China announces formal export controls on graphite
timeline.impact: Controls on high-purity synthetic and natural flake graphite disrupt global battery supply

timeline.event: China's unified export control list consolidates graphite restrictions
timeline.impact: Spheroidized graphite for battery anodes remains under strict licensing

name: Manganese
tagline: Steel strengthening and battery stability

chokePoints.title: High Purity Refining Bottleneck
chokePoints.description: While manganese ore is abundant, high-purity manganese sulphate needed for batteries is over 90% refined in China.

substituteMineral: Titanium or molybdenum in steel alloys; LFP cathodes bypass manganese in batteries

timeline.event: Robert Hadfield invents manganese steel
timeline.impact: Created massive industrial demand; manganese becomes essential for steel production

timeline.event: COMILOG founded in Gabon to exploit world's largest manganese deposit
timeline.impact: Gabon becomes second-largest global producer after South Africa

timeline.event: EV battery industry drives demand for high-purity manganese sulphate
timeline.impact: New battery-grade processing becomes 90% dominated by China

timeline.event: South Africa remains world's largest manganese producer at 36% share
timeline.impact: Energy instability and logistics challenges threaten supply reliability

name: Silicon
tagline: The foundation of the digital age

chokePoints.title: Polysilicon Concentration
chokePoints.description: Solar-grade polysilicon production is highly concentrated in specific regions, posing risks to renewable energy rollouts.

substituteMineral: Gallium Nitride (GaN) and Silicon Carbide (SiC) for power electronics
recyclingSources: IRENA End-of-Life Solar Panel Management Report 2023

timeline.event: First transistor demonstrated at Bell Labs
timeline.impact: Launched the semiconductor era; silicon eventually became the dominant material

timeline.event: Jack Kilby and Robert Noyce independently invent the integrated circuit
timeline.impact: Enabled miniaturization; foundation of the modern computing industry

timeline.event: Intel releases the 4004, world's first commercial microprocessor
timeline.impact: Silicon demand for chips skyrockets as computing industry grows

timeline.event: US enacts CHIPS and Science Act with $52.7B in semiconductor subsidies
timeline.impact: Strategic reshoring of chip manufacturing in response to supply vulnerabilities

timeline.event: China controls 70% of polysilicon for solar panels and 68% of silicon metal
timeline.impact: Western dependency on Chinese silicon processing becomes geopolitical concern

name: Gallium
tagline: Next-generation power electronics

chokePoints.title: Export Controls
chokePoints.description: China controls 98% of primary gallium production and has instituted export controls, threatening Western defense and tech sectors.

substituteMineral: Silicon-based alternatives exist but lack GaN's superior power efficiency
recyclingSources: European Commission Critical Raw Materials Report 2023

timeline.event: First GaAs (gallium arsenide) LEDs commercialized
timeline.impact: Launched gallium's role in optoelectronics and semiconductor industry

timeline.event: GaN (gallium nitride) power electronics gain commercial traction
timeline.impact: Superior efficiency drives adoption in 5G, defense radar, and fast-charging

timeline.event: China imposes export controls on gallium
timeline.impact: Near-zero gallium exports from China; global prices surge dramatically

timeline.event: China bans gallium exports to the United States
timeline.impact: Full escalation of mineral export weaponization; US scrambles for alternatives

name: Germanium
tagline: Fiber optics and infrared supremacy

chokePoints.title: Export Restrictions
chokePoints.description: Subject to recent export controls from major producers, jeopardizing supply for aerospace and defense applications.

substituteMineral: Zinc selenide for some infrared optics; silicon for some electronic uses
recyclingSources: European Commission Critical Raw Materials Report 2023

timeline.event: First transistor built using germanium at Bell Labs
timeline.impact: Germanium was the original semiconductor material before silicon took over

timeline.event: Germanium becomes essential for fiber optic cable production
timeline.impact: Telecommunications revolution drives steady germanium demand growth

timeline.event: Germanium-based infrared optics adopted for military night vision
timeline.impact: Germanium becomes critical defense material for thermal imaging

timeline.event: China imposes export controls on germanium alongside gallium
timeline.impact: Global germanium supply contracts; defense and fiber optics sectors face shortages

timeline.event: China bans germanium exports to the US
timeline.impact: Acute supply crisis for US defense infrared optics and telecommunications

name: Rare Earth Elements
tagline: The permanent magnet powerhouse

chokePoints.title: Heavy REE Monopoly
chokePoints.description: China dominates over 85% of global REE processing, and nearly 100% of heavy rare earths (like Dysprosium) separation.

substituteMineral: Ferrite magnets (vastly inferior performance for motors and turbines)
recyclingSources: European Commission Critical Raw Materials Report 2023

esgRisks.summary: REE processing in China generates toxic and radioactive tailings waste. The Bayan Obo tailings dam in Inner Mongolia is one of the largest toxic waste sites in the world.

timeline.event: China restricts REE exports during maritime dispute with Japan
timeline.impact: Prices spike 10x; exposed global dependency on Chinese rare earth processing

timeline.event: US, EU, Japan file WTO complaint against China's REE export restrictions
timeline.impact: WTO rules against China in 2014; but Chinese dominance remains

timeline.event: Mountain Pass mine in California re-opens under new ownership (MP Materials)
timeline.impact: Only significant non-Chinese REE mine in the Western hemisphere

timeline.event: China bans export of rare earth separation and smelting technologies
timeline.impact: Prevents Western nations from replicating Chinese REE processing capability

timeline.event: China imposes export controls on rare earth magnets and processing technology
timeline.impact: Threatens global EV, wind turbine, and defense motor supply chains

name: Tungsten
tagline: The hardest natural metal powering defense and industry

chokePoints.title: China Production & Processing Monopoly
chokePoints.description: China controls ~80% of mining and ~85% of tungsten refining. Feb 2025 export controls on tungsten compounds caused immediate global price spikes.

chokePoints.title: No U.S. Domestic Mining
chokePoints.description: The United States has had no commercial tungsten mine production since 2015 and remains >50% import-reliant.

substituteMineral: Molybdenum or titanium carbide in some cutting tools, but vastly inferior performance in defense applications

esgRisks.summary: China uses tungsten export controls as a geopolitical weapon, imposing restrictions in Feb 2025 citing dual-use national security concerns.

timeline.event: Elhuyar brothers isolate tungsten metal from wolframite in Spain
timeline.impact: First isolation of the element, named wolfram

timeline.event: WWII drives fierce competition for tungsten supplies between Germany and Allies
timeline.impact: Tungsten recognized as essential strategic material for armor-piercing munitions

timeline.event: Xiamen Tungsten plant founded in China
timeline.impact: Beginning of China's long-term strategy to dominate tungsten value chain

timeline.event: China imposes formal export controls on tungsten compounds
timeline.impact: Global tungsten prices surge; Western nations scramble for alternative supply chains

name: Titanium
tagline: Strength-to-weight champion for aerospace and defense

chokePoints.title: Russia-VSMPO Dependency
chokePoints.description: VSMPO-AVISMA in Russia was the world's largest titanium supplier to Western aerospace. Boeing suspended purchases in 2022 over Ukraine conflict.

substituteMineral: Aluminum or steel in some applications, but cannot match titanium's strength-to-weight ratio at extreme temperatures

esgRisks.summary: Heavy mineral sands mining along the Mozambican coast threatens coastal ecosystems and local fishing communities.

timeline.event: William Kroll develops the Kroll Process for industrial titanium sponge production
timeline.impact: Made commercial titanium production viable for the first time

timeline.event: SR-71 Blackbird enters service, built 85-93% from titanium
timeline.impact: CIA secretly purchased titanium ore from the Soviet Union through dummy companies

timeline.event: Boeing and Russia's VSMPO-AVISMA establish joint venture
timeline.impact: Russia became the primary titanium supplier to global aerospace industry

timeline.event: Boeing suspends Russian titanium purchases due to Ukraine conflict
timeline.impact: Global aerospace scrambles to diversify titanium supply chains away from Russia

name: Antimony
tagline: The invisible shield in fire safety and ammunition

chokePoints.title: China Export Ban to US
chokePoints.description: China imposed export controls on antimony in Sept 2024, then a full ban to the US in Dec 2024. Chinese exports fell 97%. Prices tripled.

chokePoints.title: No Substitutes for Key Defense Uses
chokePoints.description: Antimony has no viable substitutes for armor-piercing ammunition hardening or antimony trioxide flame retardants in defense applications.

substituteMineral: Zinc borate or aluminum hydroxide for some flame retardant uses, but inferior performance

esgRisks.summary: China weaponized antimony exports in 2024 as retaliation for US semiconductor restrictions, demonstrating willingness to use mineral supply as geopolitical leverage.

timeline.event: China accounts for 77% of global antimony production
timeline.impact: Peak Chinese dominance of antimony supply before gradual production decline

timeline.event: China imposes antimony export controls and bans exports to US
timeline.impact: Global antimony prices triple; exports from China fall 97%

timeline.event: Perpetua Resources begins first US antimony mine in Montana
timeline.impact: First domestic US antimony mining in decades, supported by Defense Production Act

timeline.event: US and allies accelerate antimony stockpiling via Defense Logistics Agency
timeline.impact: Western nations recognize critical supply chain vulnerability for defense-essential material

name: Platinum Group Metals
tagline: Catalytic powerhouse for clean air and green hydrogen

chokePoints.title: Extreme Geographic Concentration
chokePoints.description: Over 90% of PGM reserves and production are in just two countries: South Africa and Russia, both facing significant geopolitical and operational risks.

chokePoints.title: South African Infrastructure Crisis
chokePoints.description: Ongoing electricity supply disruptions (load shedding), deep-level mining costs, and labor disputes threaten PGM supply stability.

substituteMineral: No viable substitutes for catalytic converter applications; base metal catalysts are far less effective

esgRisks.summary: The 2012 Marikana massacre where police killed 34 striking miners exposed deep systemic inequalities in South Africa's platinum mining sector.
Russia's PGM exports, particularly palladium from Norilsk, are complicated by Western sanctions related to the Ukraine conflict.

timeline.event: Catalytic converters mandated in US following Clean Air Act
timeline.impact: PGMs transformed from niche metals to critical automotive materials

timeline.event: Marikana massacre: 34 miners killed by South African police
timeline.impact: Exposed severe human rights issues in PGM mining; labor relations remain volatile

timeline.event: Volkswagen Dieselgate emissions scandal exposed
timeline.impact: Collapse in diesel demand shifted PGM demand from platinum toward palladium

timeline.event: Russia-Ukraine conflict triggers Western sanctions concerns
timeline.impact: Palladium prices spike; global automakers seek to reduce Russian PGM dependency

name: Vanadium
tagline: Steel strengthener and grid-scale energy storage enabler

chokePoints.title: Chinese Processing Dominance
chokePoints.description: China controls ~60% of vanadium processing. 80% of vanadium is converted to ferrovanadium in China for steel production.

substituteMineral: Niobium, titanium, or manganese in some steel alloy applications; lithium-ion for some energy storage

timeline.event: Ti-6Al-4V alloy developed containing 4% vanadium
timeline.impact: Created the most important aerospace titanium alloy, still dominant today

timeline.event: First vanadium redox flow battery demonstrated
timeline.impact: Opened pathway for grid-scale energy storage without degradation

timeline.event: China rebar standard change increases mandatory vanadium content
timeline.impact: Major demand surge caused vanadium prices to triple within months

timeline.event: Global VRFB installations accelerate for renewable energy storage
timeline.impact: Vanadium battery sector grows rapidly, though still only ~3% of total demand

name: Bismuth
tagline: The green alternative replacing toxic lead

chokePoints.title: Chinese Refining Near-Monopoly
chokePoints.description: China produces 88% of world bismuth, entirely as a byproduct of tungsten/lead processing. Any disruption in Chinese operations cripples global supply.

chokePoints.title: Byproduct Dependency
chokePoints.description: Bismuth is never mined as a primary product - always a byproduct of lead, tungsten, and copper ore. Supply cannot be independently scaled.

substituteMineral: Tin or indium-based alloys for some applications; lead where regulations permit
recyclingSources: European Commission Critical Raw Materials Report 2023

timeline.event: Bismuth confirmed as a distinct element by Claude Geoffroy
timeline.impact: Previously confused with lead and tin for centuries

timeline.event: US ceases primary refined bismuth production
timeline.impact: America becomes entirely import-dependent for refined bismuth

timeline.event: EU bans lead in hunting ammunition, driving bismuth shot demand
timeline.impact: Bismuth demand surges as the preferred non-toxic alternative to lead shot

timeline.event: China controls 88% of world bismuth refinery production
timeline.impact: Maximum single-country concentration of any critical industrial mineral

name: Niobium
tagline: The super-steel element and superconductor enabler

chokePoints.title: Brazilian Near-Monopoly
chokePoints.description: Brazil holds 91% of world niobium reserves and produces 93% of supply, primarily through CBMM. Any Brazilian supply disruption would be devastating.

substituteMineral: Vanadium or titanium in some HSLA steel applications; tantalum for some superalloy uses

timeline.event: Charles Hatchett discovers niobium in museum specimen
timeline.impact: First identification of the element, later confused with tantalum for decades

timeline.event: CBMM founded in Araxa, Brazil on world's largest niobium deposit
timeline.impact: Brazil's path to dominating 90%+ of global niobium supply

timeline.event: Large Hadron Collider design relies on niobium-titanium superconductors
timeline.impact: Demonstrated niobium's irreplaceable role in advanced scientific applications

timeline.event: Brazil's niobium exports primarily directed to China, then Netherlands and US
timeline.impact: Geopolitical significance grows as niobium is critical for infrastructure steel

name: Tantalum
tagline: Micro-capacitor essential for every smartphone and pacemaker

chokePoints.title: Conflict Mineral Sourcing
chokePoints.description: Over 50% of tantalum comes from Central African nations with significant conflict mineral and governance risks.

substituteMineral: Aluminum or ceramic capacitors for some low-performance applications, but cannot match tantalum's capacitance density

esgRisks.summary: Tantalum mining in eastern DRC (coltan) has historically funded armed groups. Designated a conflict mineral under the 2010 US Dodd-Frank Act.
Artisanal tantalum mining in Nigeria operates with minimal regulation, significant environmental damage, and poor worker safety.

timeline.event: Anders Ekeberg discovers tantalum, naming it after Tantalus from Greek mythology
timeline.impact: Element identified but confused with niobium for 50 years

timeline.event: Coltan rush in DRC linked to Second Congo War funding
timeline.impact: Tantalum supply chain exposed as financing armed conflict

timeline.event: US Dodd-Frank Act Section 1502 designates tantalum as a conflict mineral
timeline.impact: Companies required to trace tantalum supply chains and disclose DRC sourcing

timeline.event: Global tantalum production reaches ~2,090 tonnes with growing African share
timeline.impact: Africa now dominates tantalum production; compliance and traceability remain challenges

name: Beryllium
tagline: Featherlight strength for aerospace and nuclear systems

chokePoints.title: Single-Company Dependency
chokePoints.description: Materion Corporation (USA) is the world's dominant producer of beryllium products. The Spor Mountain mine in Utah is the only significant US source.

substituteMineral: Phosphor bronze or titanium in some spring applications; no substitute for nuclear/aerospace X-ray window uses

esgRisks.summary: Beryllium dust is highly toxic and carcinogenic. Strict OSHA standards are required, and chronic beryllium disease affects workers in processing plants.

timeline.event: Beryllium first isolated independently by Wohler and Bussy
timeline.impact: Element identified from beryl mineral; remained a laboratory curiosity

timeline.event: Manhattan Project uses beryllium as neutron reflector in nuclear weapons
timeline.impact: Beryllium becomes a classified strategic material for nuclear applications

timeline.event: James Webb Space Telescope design specifies beryllium mirror segments
timeline.impact: Demonstrated beryllium's unmatched properties for precision optics in extreme environments

timeline.event: Materion Corporation remains world's dominant beryllium producer
timeline.impact: Critical single-company dependency risk for US defense supply chain

name: Chromium
tagline: The stainless steel essential no modern economy can function without

chokePoints.title: South African Energy Crisis
chokePoints.description: South Africa produces 40% of world chromite, but persistent load shedding and energy instability threaten ferrochrome smelter operations.

substituteMineral: No substitute for chromium in stainless steel; nickel can partially replace in some corrosion-resistant applications

esgRisks.summary: Ferrochrome smelting in South Africa is extremely energy-intensive, relies on coal-fired power, and generates hexavalent chromium waste, a known carcinogen.

timeline.event: Chromium discovered by Louis Nicolas Vauquelin in Paris
timeline.impact: Named for the vivid colors of its compounds

timeline.event: Harry Brearley invents stainless steel in Sheffield, England
timeline.impact: Chromium-based stainless steel revolutionizes industry, creating massive ongoing demand

timeline.event: South African sanctions during apartheid disrupt chromium supply
timeline.impact: Western nations forced to find alternative chromium sources during apartheid embargo

timeline.event: South Africa's load shedding crisis threatens chromite mining and ferrochrome smelting
timeline.impact: Energy instability raises costs and risks for world's largest chromium producer

name: Tin
tagline: The solder that connects every electronic device on Earth

chokePoints.title: Myanmar Wa State Mining Suspension
chokePoints.description: Myanmar's Wa State, a major source of tin concentrate for Chinese smelters, suspended mining operations in Aug 2023, tightening global tin supply.

chokePoints.title: Indonesian Regulatory Uncertainty
chokePoints.description: Indonesia's tin exports face periodic regulatory investigations, licensing delays, and downstreaming policies that can disrupt supply.

substituteMineral: Lead-free solder alternatives exist but still require tin as the primary component; epoxy adhesives for some limited applications

esgRisks.summary: Tin mining in Myanmar's Wa State is controlled by ethnic armed organizations with limited oversight, funding conflict and operating with poor labor conditions.
Tin dredging on Bangka and Belitung islands has devastated coral reefs and tropical forests, creating environmental dead zones.

timeline.event: International Tin Council collapse crashes tin prices globally
timeline.impact: Major market dislocation as buffer stock scheme fails, reshaping global tin trade

timeline.event: EU RoHS directive restricts lead in electronics, mandating lead-free solder
timeline.impact: Massive demand surge for tin-based lead-free solders in electronics manufacturing

timeline.event: Myanmar's Wa State suspends tin mining operations
timeline.impact: Major supply disruption for Chinese smelters; global tin market tightens significantly
